## Google Play and App Store (Platform; G-cluster cloud apps)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20240813233433/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.sqex.game.ff10 -- the `android` G-cluster row's page, FINAL FANTASY X/X-2 HDリマスター by ブロードメディア株式会社 G-cluster (package jp.co.sqex.game.ff10), 10K+ downloads, Android 6.0 or later, TV linkage supported, updated 2024-07-16, with the service-end notice; a five-title set (X, X-2, X-2 Last Mission, Eternal Calm, credits and bonus) -- user, 2026-10-22; last capture, renders
- https://web.archive.org/web/20250114091555/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff10/index_ios.html -- G-cluster's iOS game page (last capture) -- accessed 2026-10-22
- https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1297115524 -- the App Store listing (capture 2020-01-08 shows Apple's splash; the page source holds the data): one app for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch (iOS 9.0 or later) and Apple TV; the Apple TV row's app, above
  - Capture https://web.archive.org/web/20240902075547/https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/final-fantasy-x-x-2-hd%E3%83%AA%E3%83%9E%E3%82%B9%E3%82%BF%E3%83%BC/id1297115524 (2024-09-02; linked from the Japan App Store page of FF IV 3D Remake, same date) -- user, 2026-10-25
    - Japan page, Broadmedia Corporation, 12+, 2.4 from 537 ratings, free with in-app purchase (X/X-2 HD Remaster use right ¥3,400)
    - Languages: Japanese only
    - Notice: new sales stopped 2024-08-30 noon; service for buyers until 2025-02-28 noon
    - Version 1.7.000 (2023-10-10); iPhone, iPad, Apple TV; tvOS 13.0 or later; iOS 12.0 or later
    - Contents: X, X-2, Eternal Calm, X-2 Last Mission, credits and bonus
- Launch: the app on 2017-11-16, per the phone app news page (https://web.archive.org/web/20250114083821/https://gcluster.jp/sp/app/sqex/news.html); the 2023-02-28 notice there says it was also sold in KDDI's "au Game" service, which ended 2023-05-15, with buyers moved to the Google Play version
- The service ended 2025-02-28 noon, per the notice in sources/final-fantasy-franchise.md, so the rows are struck; Japan only

- Release: https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2017/11/16-001589.html (user, 2026-10-22) -- X/X-2 HD Remaster started 2017-11-16 on G-cluster, the App Store, Apple TV, Google Play, the Amazon Android app store, Amazon Fire TV, G-cluster for LEONET and COCORO GAME (Sharp's G-cluster service for AQUOS 4K TVs); the release names its Google Play and App Store pages (the same as above)
- https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/product/B0779PLP64 -- the Amazon appstore listing (ASIN B0779PLP64), as linked from G-cluster's game page http://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff10/index.html; first capture of that page https://web.archive.org/web/20171121025255/http://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff10/index.html (2017-11-21), last capture that lists it https://web.archive.org/web/20231003101330/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/ff10/index.html (2023-10-03); the link is the same in both -- user, 2026-10-23
  - Wayback captures of the listing (`/gp/product/` and `/dp/` forms, 2019 to 2025) are 503, 404, a redirect to Amazon's not-found page, or Amazon's bot-check page; none shows the app (raw HTML read 2026-10-23); the CDX prefix `amazon.co.jp/dp/B0779PLP64*` (user, 2026-10-23) lists six captures, all read as raw HTML: two 200s (2025-11-04, bare and `tag=` forms) are Amazon's bot-check page, the 2024-03-04 `ref=sr_1_7` capture is 503, the others (2022-07-19, 2023-11-13, 2025-05-04) are 404, 503 and 302; `amazon.co.jp/gp/product/B0779PLP64*` (user, 2026-10-23) lists three captures: 2019-02-22 (`ref=s9_acsd_hps_bw_c_x_2_w…`) and 2019-06-29 are 503, 2025-08-29 is 200 but Amazon's bot-check page; `ref=sr_1_1` to `sr_1_9` forms have no capture; domain scans (`amazon.co.jp/*` prefix, `filter=original:.*B0779PLP64.*`) for title-slug forms returned no results for 2017-11-01 to 2018-06-30 (a blank page) and for 2023-08-01 to 2023-08-31; the control scan (IX's ASIN B075MCK6XC over 2023-08-01 to 2023-08-31, user, 2026-10-23) also returned no results although the capture https://web.archive.org/web/20230814145211/https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B075MCK6XC/ref=sr_1_6 exists, so this scan does not find known captures and its blanks prove nothing
